level.verb: flip a worker's papers, staff the jobs
level.scene: Morning roll-call in a sub-division store yard: office, poles, van, a notice board with today's job cards (header date '11-11-2026'), a wooden tray 'আজ নয় — প্রশিক্ষিত লোক চাই'. A gang of 3–4 plus the player's own figure (foreman's clipboard), name strips on shirts. A worker's papers open as a 5-sleeve card wallet: ID (নাম, জন্ম সাল), ITI, ওয়ার্কম্যান পারমিট (State Electrical Licensing Board), training certificates (লাইভ লাইন প্রশিক্ষণ, HV কেবিল জয়েন্টিং সার্টিফিকেশন, ফার্স্ট এইড ও ফায়ার সেফটি), logbook summary, empty sleeves. Job cards: 'শাটডাউনে লাইন মেরামত', 'ঠিকাদারের লাইন রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ — শর্ত: ওয়ার্কম্যান পারমিট', 'HV কেবিল জয়েন্ট', '11 kV লাইভ লাইন কাজ'. Judge: the module's only crew-papers/roster level (do_7_1_b no longer uses crew cards).
flow: Guide first: 'আজ আপনি দলের ফোরম্যান! কাগজ দেখে ঠিক লোককে ঠিক কাজ দিন।'
Corner guide 'আগে কার কাগজ দেখবেন?'. Tap a worker (or yourself) → wallet; swipe the 5 sleeves (fresh order each play); a 'seen' dog-ear equal for all.
Drag a worker onto a job card (one per card, undo allowed). Drag a card into the 'আজ নয়' tray to hold it; undo allowed.
All cards filled or held → 'শিফট শুরু' rises; it and the live-line drop wait for the coworker if he has not come in his round.

Pressure moment once per play in the live-line round (2 or 3). Beat 1: myth 2 word for word, pointing at a dealt uncertified worker (or the player). Beat 2: chip, 'ওঁর কথা শুনবেন?', deck. Listening drops him on the live-line card and starts the shift (deadly).
'শিফট শুরু' → judged in board order: right → walks off, praise, ◆; right hold → stamped, ◆; wrong → MistakeCard + strike; deadly → freeze first.
One reason deck per round on its key decision.
Round 1: 3 workers, 2 jobs; round 2: 4 workers, 3 jobs; round 3: 4 + own wallet, 3 jobs, sometimes a job nobody can take.
Pass panel ('আজ যা ধরলেন': which certificate fitted which job).
level.dealtVariety: Gangs from ~10 profiles with looks dealt apart from papers; job cards and order; sleeve order; live-line round; coworker's target; whether anyone holds the live-line certificate; reason deals; a solver guarantees a correct roster and holds right only when no free qualified worker exists. JUDGE RULE: adults' জন্ম সাল ≤ 2006, minors 2009–2010, never 2007–2008 (so the board date decides cleanly).
deadly: Anyone without the লাইভ লাইন প্রশিক্ষণ certificate on '11 kV লাইভ লাইন কাজ' (veteran, fresh ITI, under-18, or the player without it)
Listening to the coworker's push onto the live-line job
slips: 'HV কেবিল জয়েন্ট' without the jointing certification
Contractor job without a workman permit (ITI, company ID or first-aid paper taken for it)
Any non-live line job to the under-18 helper
Any line job to the fresh joiner with an empty logbook
level.coworkerPushBn: Once, in the live-line round, at the first of: opening the target's wallet, touching the live-line card, or tapping 'শিফট শুরু' (held). Myth 2 word for word: 'লাইসেন্স বা সার্টিফিকেট তো শুধু কাগজে দেখানোর জন্য, আসল তো হলো কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা।' Refuse: 'না — সার্টিফিকেটই প্রমাণ উনি নিরাপদে করতে প্রশিক্ষিত' / 'না — লাইভ লাইনে প্রশিক্ষণের কাগজ ছাড়া কাউকে নয়'. Listen (≥ 5): 'হ্যাঁ — 20 বছরের হাত, কাগজ লাগে না' / 'হ্যাঁ — অভিজ্ঞতাই আসল, কাগজ পরে হবে' / 'হ্যাঁ — ফার্স্ট এইডের কাগজ তো আছেই' / 'হ্যাঁ — আজ একবার, কেউ দেখবে না' / 'হ্যাঁ — উনি নিজেই বলছেন পারবেন'.
reasonQuestionsBn: লাইভ লাইনের কাজ কেন ওঁকে দিলেন?
লাইভ লাইনের কাজ কেন আজ 'আজ নয়' ট্রেতে রাখলেন?
HV কেবিল জয়েন্ট কেন ওঁকে দিলেন?
ছেলেটাকে কেন লাইনের কাজ দিলেন না?
নতুন ছেলেটিকে কেন কাজে পাঠালেন না?
level.gestureHints: Yard, nothing placed: sweep over every gang figure incl. the player's. Wallet open: swipe hint right-to-left always. After a wallet seen, cards empty: drag nudge from the last-opened worker straight up ≤ 96 dp. Unfilled after that: sweep over job cards and the tray together. All filled: tap ripple on 'শিফট শুরু'. Decks: built-in. Off during intro, coworker beat 1, freeze, cards, results.
lessonPoints: বিদ্যুৎ লাইনে কাজ করার জন্য একজন ব্যক্তিকে 'উপযুক্ত' (Competent) হতে হবে। এর মানে হলো, তার বয়স ১৮ বছরের বেশি হতে হবে এবং … পর্যাপ্ত প্রশিক্ষণ এবং অভিজ্ঞতা থাকতে হবে …
প্রশিক্ষণ ছাড়া আপনাকে কোনো ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ কাজে পাঠানোটা আইনের লঙ্ঘন।
রাজ্য সরকারের লাইসেন্সিং বোর্ড (State Electrical Licensing Board) থেকে একটি 'ওয়ার্কম্যান পারমিট' বা লাইসেন্স নিতে হয়।
অনেক বড় কোম্পানি বা ঠিকাদারের কাজ পাওয়ার জন্য এটি একটি আবশ্যক শর্ত।
উদাহরণ: লাইভ লাইন কাজের প্রশিক্ষণ, হাই-ভোল্টেজ কেবিল জয়েন্টিং-এর সার্টিফিকেশন, ফার্স্ট এইড এবং ফায়ার সেফটি ট্রেনিং।
লাইসেন্স বা সার্টিফিকেট আপনার সেই অভিজ্ঞতাকে একটি আনুষ্ঠানিক এবং আইনগত স্বীকৃতি দেয়।
level.giveawayRisks: Nothing judged before 'শিফট শুরু'; row, card and sleeve order shuffled; every wallet 5 sleeves; looks apart from papers; coworker not in the gang and his target dealt; no ticks; job cards never name the needed certificate except the contractor's printed condition; needless hold costs; guide lines restate only.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Module deadly list: unsigned field copy or verbal permit; torn/unrated 11 kV gloves (and no gloves on a hook); cut harness webbing; live hook removal; uncertified person on energised live-line work; charging the line with a man up (F12); a public rod/bamboo reaching the line (7.3b); letting the coworker coil a wire not proven dead (7.7a S2); entering a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a slip. Confirm each 'needsOwner' row.
ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 'deadly' list (level ends at once): field PTW copy not signed, or a spoken 'line off' with no paper; torn or wrong-rated gloves on an 11 kV job; cut harness strap; pulling a theft hook off a live line; untrained man on live-line work; asking to charge the line while a man is still up; a passer-by's rod touching the line because you did not warn; letting a coworker coil a fallen wire not proven dead; walking into a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a small mistake (slip). Confirm?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved as written: the module deadly list; everything else = slip; every needsOwner row on that list is confirmed.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Every row already matches an earlier ruling; the glove change is A5.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm the list, with one change: no gloves on a hook is deadly only while the line is not yet proven dead and earthed. After tester 0 V and earth, missing gloves (or any PPE) = slip. Listening to the coworker takes the class of the act he pushes.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M1 step 17 + B7 (no PTW = deadly). B6 (bad glove = deadly). M1 steps 11-12 (harness). B8/X1 (touching live = deadly). M5-1 (charging with anyone on the line = deadly). M5-5 (bystander contact = deadly). M5-4 (inside 10 m = deadly). A5/X4 (no PPE after a proven isolation = slip). B1 (listening = class of the act).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped = deadly (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Accept, or make both heavy slips?
ownerDecisions.question: If the player could have stopped another person touching a live wire and did not (a passer-by's bamboo in 7.3b, a coworker coiling a wire in 7.7a), is that deadly?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: DEADLY: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Matches M6-1 (signing a broken earth because coworker B said so = deadly).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Deadly, but only after a clear, timed chance to warn. A late but successful stop = slip.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-5: a bystander's contact = deadly for the player; late but successful stop = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: past acts judged at an inquiry desk are always slips (do_7_4_b), while the same act done in the field carries its own class (F12). Accept?

ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: past acts judged at an inquiry desk (do_7_4_b) are always slips; the same act in the field keeps its own class.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-6: harm with nobody exposed = slip. Game rule, no safety reference decides it.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Reg 3 split: non-live line work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without its certificate = deadly (7.10a only). Accept, or make all Reg 3 cases slips?
ownerDecisions.question: Untrained or unauthorized man on shutdown (dead) line work = slip. Man without the live-line certificate on live-line work = deadly (7.10a only). Accept this split?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: non-live work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without the certificate = deadly (7.10a only).

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: X1 logic: on a proven-dead, earthed line the main protection is in place. CEA 2023 Reg 3(3) and Schedule I Part-I(1) (hotline work only by trained men).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Lessons with no deadly: 7.1, 7.2, 7.8, 7.9 (and do_7_3_a, do_7_4_b, do_7_5_a, do_7_7_b). Confirm.
